changelog: Hogwarts Legacy & Universal Native Game Contrast Fix v0.1.10
features: Native Game Color Fidelity: Preserves monitor-accurate lighting and colors directly from game backbuffers without artificial gamma squaring
Zero Cross-Game Regressions: Universal default srgbCorrection=false prevents crushed blacks across DX11, DX12, and future titles
Live In-Game Toggle: In-headset VR overlay allows real-time sRGB toggle if desired
OTA & Bundle Parity: Packaged releases and OTA updates synchronize clean configuration invariants
fixes: Fixed Hogwarts Legacy appearing with pitch-black crushed shadows, restoring natural desktop lighting and wall textures
Guaranteed Sekiro and all other titles maintain authentic desktop-quality lighting without gamma crush
Hardened launcher fallback profiles for Hogwarts Legacy and Sekiro
